# Install latest Aspera Connect desktop (with Show QR)

# 1) Quit Aspera Connect completely (tray icon too — right-click Quit)

# 2) Download + FORCE reinstall (same version number used to skip update)
curl -L --http1.1 -o /tmp/AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb \
  "https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb"

sudo apt install -y --reinstall /tmp/AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb
# if apt still skips:
# sudo dpkg -i /tmp/AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb

# 3) Open Aspera Connect again
# Phone calls page must show a blue button: "Show QR to pair"
# Tap it → big QR appears → phone Scan PC QR

# Verify binary has QR:
# strings $(which aspera-connect) | grep -F "Show QR" | head
